title: Regime-Aware Specialist Routing for Volatility Forecasting
summary: This paper by Tenghan Zhong proposes a regime-aware specialist routing framework for ETF volatility forecasting, combining different forecasting specialists across calm and stressed market states using online risk-sensitive evaluation and state-dependent gating. The framework reduces high-volatility forecast loss by approximately 24% and underprediction loss by approximately 22% relative to rolling-best baseline.
key_points: Framework uses online risk-sensitive evaluation and state-dependent gating to combine forecasting specialists
Tested on a daily panel of six ETFs under rolling walk-forward design
The strongest forecaster is regime-dependent rather than global
Reduces high-volatility forecast loss by approximately 24% relative to rolling-best baseline
Reduces underprediction loss by approximately 22% relative to rolling-best baseline
Authors claim specialist routing provides practical adaptive forecasting architecture for changing market conditions
why_it_matters: This research paper presents a quantitative methodology for regime-dependent volatility forecasting with direct applications to market microstructure and trading strategy. The finding that specialist routing provides practical adaptive forecasting architecture for changing market conditions has implications for risk management, options pricing, and market structure research. While not a macro catalyst, this methodology is relevant to market participants and quantitative finance research.
